chunks: We are not going to be damned.
ai.seo_question: Who is speaking in Surah Al-Shu'ara when they say 'We are not going to be damned'?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Shu'ara (26:10), the Quraysh declare their immunity from punishment, reflecting the recurring Quranic motif of the arrogant disbelievers who dismiss divine warnings as mere poetry or madness. Shia exegesis highlights this as a psychological defense mechanism against the truth, contrasting their temporary worldly confidence with the inevitable accountability emphasized in the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings. This verse sets the stage for the narrative of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) enduring similar ridicule while remaining steadfast in his mission.
